display_long_description:
The XR-based Firefighting Equipment Inspection and Operation Simulation System is educational content designed to teach the inspection and operation methods of firefighting equipment.
In environments where training is difficult due to time and spatial constraints, users can experience inspection and operation procedures in a virtual environment using Quest Pro and Quest 3, allowing them to learn proper usage methods.

This content enables hands-on experience with CO₂ fire extinguishers, sprinklers, pre-action systems, fire shutters, and gaseous fire suppression systems within the XR-based Firefighting Equipment Inspection and Operation Simulation System.

Users will understand the operating principles of CO₂ fire extinguishers, sprinklers, pre-action systems, fire shutters, and gaseous fire suppression systems, and conduct practical training. After completing the training, an evaluation of the learning outcomes is conducted.

This content can only be operated in the Quest Pro and Quest 3 environments.

This content is a version of the XR-based Firefighting Equipment Inspection and Operation Simulation System that provides CO₂ fire extinguishers, sprinklers, pre-action systems, fire shutters, and gaseous fire suppression systems.
